async function run(
	groups: Row[][],
	other: Row[],
	read: (item: Row) => Promise<Row>,
) {
	for (const batch of groups) {
		report(batch.length);
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all<Row>(
			batch.filter((item) => item.enabled).map(read),
		);
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.allSettled<Row>(
			batch
				.filter((item) => item.enabled && item.readyForAnotherAttempt)
				.map(read),
		);
	}
	for (const item of other) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all<Row>([read(item)]);
	}
}
